discovery: Cosmic inflation and the quantum origin of cosmological structure
motivation: Guth proposed that an early epoch of exponential expansion explains why the universe is flat, homogeneous and free of relic monopoles. Linde turned this into a working theory: new and chaotic inflation, a slowly rolling scalar field with a graceful exit. Mukhanov (with Chibisov) showed that quantum vacuum fluctuations stretched by inflation seed all cosmic structure, and predicted a nearly scale-invariant, Gaussian, adiabatic spectrum with a small red tilt. Decades of precision measurements of the cosmic microwave background and large-scale structure, from COBE and WMAP to Planck and ground-based telescopes, have confirmed these predictions in detail. They include a spectral index measurably below one, at about 0.965. This is one of the deepest syntheses in physics. Galaxies, and we ourselves, are quantum fluctuations magnified to cosmic scales. The theory joins quantum field theory and gravity at the highest energies we can access, and it now guides the search for primordial gravitational waves.
